summary: Every requirement and ruling in the plan is delivered by a merged phase and I can point at the implementing work for all nineteen acceptance criteria: R1 by renew-internal-tls.yml (P2) plus the two new stages in Jenkinsfile.iac-scheduled-certs (P3), the coverage ruling by the one play over proxmox:k8s:openbao with srvk8s4 dropping out through the microk8s gate P1 hoisted, the serialize-without-losing-coverage ruling by throttle: 1 with an in-task readiness wait on Restart microk8s kubelite and throttle: 1 on Reload openbao (P1) plus force_handlers and no serial: on the play (P2), the single-declaration ruling by the three per-consumer internal_tls task files (P1), the stalled-renewer ruling by the job's own red-or-unstable signal with no Prometheus claim anywhere (P3), and the doctrine ruling by decisions.md:26 and :294 (P4). No done-record admits a leftover that the loop's own later stages do not own: the three doc leftovers P1/P2/P4 named (proxmox_host/README.md:55, playbooks/README.md, decisions.md:140's 'has no scheduled driver', which this slice falsifies) are diff-based reconciliation on surfaces 1 and 3 of docs/slice-doc-plan.md, which is the doc phase's job and not a phase of the plan. Everything else outstanding is already close-out material at close-out weight - nine bugs and four suggestions, none of which the plan owes. I fixed three prose inaccuracies as mechanical residue rather than reporting them: the no-serial comment in renew-internal-tls.yml blamed max_fail_percentage (Ansible b7de205), and decisions.md:26 credited both throttled handlers with a readiness wait and stated the never-two-nodes invariant in a form the endorsed playbook contradicts (AnsibleSpecs c4c048c); kc project lint, build and test are green on the fixed tree and B5, B8 and B9 are struck.
